base: SGGL = M6 A2x (self gate, centre follows output); SGGL-V = A2x + global score > 0 (M6.1 A2v, post-hoc)

sets.DEV: 21 M6 dev crop units (gate set DAVIS_val+PUMaVOS_B = 13, aux PUMaVOS_A + SegTrack = 8)
sets.REP: 43 DAVIS-2017-train crop units / 23 videos (M6.1 replication; miami-surf = discovery case)
sets.VK: 28 VKITTI2 Scene01/06 clone crop units (2 scenes, synthetic, many same-class distractors); NOT used during screening/revision; run once per frozen finalist + SGGL + SGGL-V
sets.C: PUMaVOS C untouched; at most one run for the single final frozen method meeting the final rule

development_data: DEV + REP (both previously inspected => every M7 screening result is exploratory)
training_data: learned modules (T family, any fitted gate) fit on REP videos only (DAVIS train); video-disjoint inner split for validation curves; evaluated on DEV (+ VK for finalists). REP is then not an evaluation set for that module (reported).
metric: per-unit mean J&F over frames 1..n-1 (prompt frame excluded, M5.5 J/F); delta vs SGGL and vs P5 (= the live G state, identical to B1); CIs: 2000x bootstrap clustered by video; small = prompt area < 1%, tiny = < 0.1%
stage0_recording: live SGGL rollout on DEV+REP storing per frame: low-res logits of G, L, L2 (2x crop side, same centre), L protected-memory probe (prompt memory only), L trusted-memory probe (non-cond memory restricted to frames where L and G agreed: both scores > 0 and IoU > 0.5, backfilled), G protected probe (scalars), L resolution probe (crop image down/up-sampled to G's effective resolution of that region; same memory) on event frames (presence disagreement or IoU<0.5) and every 10th frame; frozen frame-0 identity references (mask-pooled stride-16 backbone features) and per-frame cosine maps in both views. Production outputs must equal SGGL exactly.
replay_screening: output-only candidates are first screened by replay on the recorded SGGL trajectory (label: REPLAY). Any candidate that changes the output must be confirmed by a causal rollout (centre follows its own output) before it can ADVANCE.

pilot_rule.ADVANCE: pooled small crop units of DEV+REP: dJF vs SGGL >= +0.005 AND >= 3 videos improved by > 0.01 AND leave-one-video-out min > 0 AND still > 0 without miami-surf AND no unit < -0.05 vs SGGL
pilot_rule.REJECT: pooled dJF vs SGGL <= 0, or all gain from <= 2 videos with LOVO min <= 0
pilot_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, or a learned module failing its positive control

learned_positive_control: overfit 64 fixed REP frames: train-set J gain >= +0.05 over the frozen input mask within 1500 steps, loss decreasing; else the T result is INCONCLUSIVE (not a negative result)
final_rule: the final method must beat SGGL on pooled small DEV+REP crop units with video-CI lower bound > 0 in a causal rollout, not regress on VK (dJF vs SGGL >= -0.005, 2 scenes => descriptive), and have no DEV/REP unit < -0.05 vs SGGL; otherwise KEEP_SGGL or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
multiplicity: about 15-25 candidate comparisons on the same development videos; a screening winner is exploratory until VK/C or new data; reported as such
